description: highly detailed HD pixel art with painterly shading and layered depth, a cinematic wide establishing shot for a trucking tycoon game: Ontario in the Inland Empire: warehouse sprawl, rail yards and mountains, its real skyline rising in the middle distance with every landmark clearly recognisable, seen from above a busy interstate in the foreground where American long-nose conventional semi tractors with long hoods, chrome grilles and sleeper cabs pull white trailers, never a flat-faced European cab-over truck, a blank green overhead highway sign, the city's own surroundings and water or hills beyond, deep night under a dark blue starry sky, the skyline ablaze with lit windows, neon and red beacon lights on the tower tops, headlights and taillights streaming along the freeway, warm pools of streetlight, the landmarks floodlit, no text, lettering, words, labels or logos anywhere
